newsitem.title: BELGIUM: D'Ieteren to decide soon on Avis listing.
newsitem.headline: D'Ieteren to decide soon on Avis listing.

text.p: Belgian car importer and distributor D'Ieteren said on Monday it would decide later this month whether to list fast-growing car hire company Avis Europe on the London stock exchange.
"That's right, absolutely," a spokeswoman for D'Ieteren told Reuters when asked whether a decision on the listing was expected later this month.

She declined to comment further or confirm a report on Saturday by the Financieel Economische Tijd newspaper that D'Ieteren would announce Avis Europe's return to the London bourse in the first half of this month.
D'Ieteren has 77.1 percent of Avis Europe, Avis Inc 8.7 percent and General Motors (GM) 14.2 percent.
Avis Europe was floated in London in 1986. It was bought three years later by D'Ieteren-controlled Cilva Holdings Plc.
D'Ieteren said last June that Avis Europe would not be listed again before 1998 and that it would still keep a majority in Avis Europe if it was listed again.
At 1115 GMT, D'Ieteren was up 250 francs, or 3.7 percent, at 6,950 francs on the Brussels bourse after earlier setting a new year high of 7,030.
